dimensions.evidence: The Secretary may reduce the amount to be reimbursed... if the Secretary determines that full reimbursement would impose an economic hardship

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes discretionary offsetting collections credited to Interior accounts to cover administrative, processing, and inspection costs.
dimensions.evidence: shall be credited to the currently applicable appropriation, account, or fund of the Department of the Interior as discretionary offsetting collections
